hooks.command: f="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.llocal/running_process/PROCESSES.md"; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; a=""; for p in $(sed -n 's/^- pid: \([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' "$f"); do kill -0 "$p" 2>/dev/null && a="$a $p"; done; [ -n "$a" ] && printf '{"systemMessage":"Background processes from this session are still alive (pid:%s). Stop them (see kill: in .llocal/running_process/PROCESSES.md) or delete the stale entry."}\n' "$a"; exit 0
